name: Amna Mazen
title: Assistant Professor, joint appointment in Applied Computing and Manufacturing and Mechanical Engineering Technology
department: Applied Computing; Manufacturing and Mechanical Engineering Technology; Robotics and Remote Sensing Laboratory
fitReason: Officially dated 2024 Assistant Professor with substantive learned perception integrated into physical assistive object retrieval. Strong applied CS/robotics fit; current research-visit availability and access to the collaborative apparatus are unknown.

physicalEvidence.summary: The full February 2026 Robotics paper trains YOLOv8n on 247 custom images and uses RGB-D localization to drive actual ReactorX-200 grasping on a Pioneer P3-DX mobile platform. Speech recognition supplies commands; navigation and arm planning remain classical. Controlled laboratory retrieval/delivery was tested with four lightweight object categories, without external participants. Mazen is credited with methodology, validation and supervision; the student coauthors are affiliated with Detroit Mercy, and current Michigan Tech ownership/site is not established. Reported subsystem rates are not an end-to-end success estimate.

shortVisit.summary: The verified research recruitment is a dated Spring 2025 PhD call. The current lab describes graduate research and collaboration, but no distinct invitation for external master’s research visitors or summer interns was established.

scoreReasons.physical: Actual executed learned perception is verified; collaborative student affiliations and unverified current host apparatus cap the score.

name: Joseph A. Campbell
title: Assistant Professor of Computer Science; CAMP Lab Director
department: Computer Science; Collaborative AI for Machines and People (CAMP) Lab, West Lafayette
fitReason: Assistant Professor appointed in Fall 2024, with current lab-linked VLM-guided reinforcement learning and actual FR3 manipulation. Advertised BS/MS intake requires Purdue enrollment; a separate outside-master visiting route is unverified.

physicalEvidence.summary: The March 2026 CDE revision uses VLM-derived object concepts for auxiliary representation learning and intrinsic rewards in visual RL. Section V-H transfers the learned controller to a real Franka Research 3 with a wrist camera, completing Lift in 8 of 10 trials without real-world fine-tuning. The other five-task benchmark is simulated, and the VLM is unnecessary at deployment. Lead author Le Mao is independently listed as a current CAMP visiting scholar with this project, supporting current-group attribution; this does not establish visitor hardware access.
